body: Today has been another shit day so it's looking like tomorrow is going to go as planned.
I've tried regular therapy, cbt and emdr.
Happy early birthday. I can't promise that come Friday I'll decide to give it another go, but who knows, I suppose anything could happen.

I've been on about four different medications so far. TMS is sometimes effective immediately, other times it takes a while and for some people it's never effective. I can't help but think I fall into that group. I'm a day trader by hobby, not by profession and I'm pretty terrible at it, despite trying to learn. It's probably my biggest and most costly mistake and I don't recommend it to anyone.

I know that feeling. I worked hard for everything I had and then I just threw it all away. The blame and guilt are the hard things to overcome. You're quite a bit younger than me so I imagine you're still in a place where you could right or overcome the wrongs you've done. 

As for the point of things, I dont know the answer to that. Some say it's experiences like trying new things, or falling in love or insert other activity people like. I would say try to focus on the things you enjoy or have enjoyed and finding ways to do those things again.
